brief_title: Liraglutide as Add on Therapy on Metformin in Women With Polycystic Ovary Syndrome

interventions.name: Glucophage tablets and Victoza
other_names: Glucophage tablets and Victoza 6 mg/ml solution for injection in pre-filled pen

primary_outcomes.time_frame: up to 12 weeks of clinical trial

primary_outcomes.measure: The number of good responders to combined treatment regarding body weight
primary_outcomes.time_frame: up to 12 weeks of clinical trial

brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to determine whether combined treatment with liraglutide and metformin is more effective than metformin as monotherapy in the treatment of obese women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). We anticipated greater changes in body weight in patients on combined treatment than in those on monotherapy.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years old to menopause
* polycystic ovary syndrome (NICHD criteria)
* BMI of 30 kg/m² or higher

Exclusion Criteria:

* type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus
* history of carcinoma
* Cushing's syndrome or congenital (non-classic) adrenal hyperplasia
* personal or family history of MEN 2
* significant cardiovascular, kidney or hepatic disease
* the use of medications known or suspected to affect reproductive or metabolic functions
* the use of statins, within 90 days prior to study entry
